$note.skillBonusXp: XP banked in each of the four class-related skills when a new class level is claimed; respec cannot replay this award.
$note.ability.base: XP required to advance an ability skill from its first activated level.
$note.ability.growthPerLevel: Additional XP required for each successive Spellcraft or Combat Maneuvers skill level.
$note.ability.maxLevel: The highest available Spellcraft or Combat Maneuvers skill level.
$note.ability.ranksAt.0: The ability skill level that makes rank 0 card profiles available in normal offers.
$note.ability.ranksAt.1: The ability skill level that makes rank 1 card profiles available in normal offers.
$note.ability.ranksAt.2: The ability skill level that makes rank 2 card profiles available in normal offers.
$note.ability.ranksAt.3: The ability skill level that makes rank 3 card profiles available in normal offers.
$note.ability.ranksAt.4: The ability skill level that makes rank 4 card profiles available in normal offers.
$note.ability.ranksAt.5: The ability skill level that makes rank 5 card profiles available in normal offers.
$note.ability.xp.magical: Spellcraft XP awarded once when a card resolves a magical effect.
$note.ability.xp.spell: Additional Spellcraft XP awarded once for playing a Spell, including a Cantrip.
$note.ability.xp.manaSpell: Additional Spellcraft XP per printed Mana point on a Spell; discounts do not reduce this award.
$note.ability.xp.technique: Combat Maneuvers XP awarded once for a physical Technique with no printed Mana cost.
$note.ability.xp.maneuver: Combat Maneuvers XP awarded once for a physical maneuver with a printed Mana cost.
$note.ability.draftSize: Distinct card families shown at the normal available rank in each saved ability offer.
$note.ability.intelligenceChance: Chance per Intelligence point for a fourth, higher-rank card option, capped at certainty.
$note.ability.bonusRankDepth: Maximum number of ranks above the normal offer for the Intelligence bonus option, capped at rank five.
$note.respec.enabled: Allows a class respec preview and atomic exchange of eligible choices through the current class level.
